CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ndaSigningAuditLog (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  ndaSigningId INT NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  userId INT,
  details TEXT,
  ipAddress VARCHAR(45),
  userAgent TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
